This supports that he kept diplomatic channels open early in the crisis.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.8","1B.4"]},{"title":"ANGOLA - RDC : Les Présidents Joao Lourenço et Félix Tshisekedi échangent à huis clos sur la situation sécuritaire à l’Est de la RDC","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-27","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/angola_rdc_les_presidents_joao_lourenco_et_felix_tshisekedi_echangent_a_huis_clos_sur_la_situation_securitaire_a_lest_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi met Angola’s president in a closed-door meeting on the east DRC crisis, following the Addis-Ababa mini-summit. This shows continued reliance on mediation rather than immediate escalation.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"Tshisekedi called for an urgent relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability. That is direct evidence of choosing negotiation over force when a diplomatic path existed.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Les Téké et les Yaka s’engagent à mettre fin aux hostilités dans l’ouest de la Rdc","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-04-06","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/les_teke_et_les_yaka_sengagent_a_mettre_fin_aux_hostilites_dans_louest_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi presided over a local peace agreement in western DRC where the parties committed to dialogue, mediation, and arbitration. This is a clear example of compromise being used instead of force.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi Et Joao Lourenco appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"Tshisekedi backed the Luanda process, welcomed the 4 August ceasefire, and said his government was available for next negotiation steps. This is strong evidence that he still chose de-escalation when a ceasefire option existed.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with H.E. Mr. Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo","publisher":"UN Secretary-General","date":"2024-09-24","url":"https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french","summary":"The UN said Tshisekedi discussed eastern DRC and ongoing regional peace efforts with the Secretary-General. That is independent confirmation that he preserved diplomatic channels rather than defaulting to force.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]},{"title":"Face à la presse, le Président Félix Tshisekedi a peint un tableau d’espoir de la RDC","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-23","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and described the eastern security problem in force-forward terms, while still saying he wanted lasting peace. This is the clearest counter-signal that force remained a preferred instrument, not merely a last resort.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Le Chef de L'état a présidé le Conseil supérieur de la défense","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-05","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/le_chef_de_l_etat_a_preside_le_conseil_superieur_de_la_defense","summary":"Tshisekedi convened the Supreme Defense Council on North Kivu and the defense establishment asked to lift the treason death-penalty moratorium. This reflects a hardline security approach alongside diplomacy, weakening a clean “compromise over force” interpretation.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Congo and Rwanda say peace talks in Angola will not take place","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-12-15","url":"https://theprint.in/world/congo-and-rwanda-say-peace-talks-in-angola-will-not-take-place/2404370/","summary":"Reuters reported the Angola summit collapsed after deadlock over direct DRC-M23 dialogue. This does not prove bad faith, but it shows that by year-end Tshisekedi’s peace channel had stalled rather than resolved the crisis.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.8"]}]}
